title: Spatiotemporal visualization of DNA replication by click chemistry reveals bubbling of viral DNA in virion formation
authors: Gomez-Gonzalez A; Burkhardt P; Bauer M; Loehr MO; Luedtke NW; Greber UF
one_liner_zh: 该研究用点击化学成像腺病毒DNA复制，发现病毒DNA在52K凝聚体中的液-液相分离成病毒颗粒，涉及相分离但非无序蛋白PPI，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅间接相关。
abstract: The organisation of human chromosomes reversibly changes in cell division, and irreversibly in apoptosis or erythropoiesis by DNA condensation and fragmentation processes. Yet, how viral replication in the nucleus affects host and viral chromatin organisation remains poorly understood. Here we used dual-color click chemistry to image human adenovirus DNA replication, demonstrating host chromatin compaction during active expansion of the viral replication compartment (VRC). Early-replicated viral DNA (vDNA) segregated from VRC and lost phospho-serine5-RNA Pol-II and viral DNA-binding protein (DBP), while late-replicated vDNA retained active RNA Pol-II, besides viral RNA-splicing and DNA-packaging proteins. Depending on replication and the assembly protein 52K, the late-stage VRCs gave rise to progeny by droplet formation of vDNA with GFP-tagged virion protein V into 52K biomolecular condensates. The study reveals distinct functions of early and late-replicated vDNA and provides insight into active and passive liquid phase separated zones conducive to selective genome packaging of nascent virions.
abstract_zh: 人类染色体的组织在细胞分裂中可逆地变化，在凋亡或红细胞生成过程中通过DNA凝聚和片段化过程不可逆地变化。然而，核内病毒复制如何影响宿主及病毒染色体的组织仍知之甚少。在此，我们使用双色点击化学成像人类腺病毒DNA复制，展示了在病毒复制区室（VRC）活跃扩张期间宿主染色质的压缩。早期复制的病毒DNA（vDNA）与VRC分离，并失去磷酸化丝氨酸5-RNA聚合酶II和病毒DNA结合蛋白（DBP），而晚期复制的vDNA保留活跃的RNA聚合酶II，以及病毒RNA剪接和DNA包装蛋白。依赖于复制和组装蛋白52K，晚期VRC通过vDNA与GFP标记的病毒粒子蛋白V形成液滴，进入52K生物分子凝聚体，从而产生子代病毒。该研究揭示了早期和晚期复制vDNA的不同功能，并为有利于新生病毒粒子选择性基因组包装的主动和被动液相分离区域提供了见解。
